nodes.label: Red Terracotta Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style red terracotta (hardened clay) texture. Deep brick-red to brownish-red solid surface with very subtle pixel variation suggesting fired clay. Matte earthy appearance, darker and more brownish than orange terracotta. Color palette: brick red (#983020), deep red-brown (#882818), slightly lighter red (#A83828). Game purpose: decorative building block dyed in red; found naturally in mesa/badlands biomes and crafted by dyeing hardened clay; popular for rustic and warm-toned architectural builds.
nodes.pattern: nearly uniform deep brick-red surface with faint pixel-level clay texture
